policy_nl:
First week on the banking mortgage desk? Read this twice.

Identity drives everything: approve_mortgage, reject_appointment, settle_complaint, and unfreeze_order all need the caller verified before they run. Verification means pulling their endorsement with get_endorsement_details on the iban. No iban yet? Ask for it, pull, then go back to the request. The same four stay strictly on the authenticated customer's own records.

Eligibility — status, time window, tier — gates approve_mortgage, settle_complaint, and unfreeze_order; nothing downstream checks it, so unmet means decline. The same three are also blocked whenever the target record is frozen or already closed out.

Inputs: approve_mortgage, reject_appointment, and unfreeze_order only take values inside policy limits; out of range, you refuse.

Finally, reject_appointment, settle_complaint, and unfreeze_order need the details read back and an explicit yes before they fire. lookup_complaint_details and lookup_loan_details are unrestricted.

Logistics consignments desk:

- ID first: extend_account, get_rider_details, list_contract_details, reinstate_consignment, reject_order, reject_subscription, unfreeze_manifest — verify via inspect_rebate_details on the serial number; unverified -> get serial number, verify, retry.
- Value limits (no backend check): extend_account, get_rider_details, list_contract_details, reinstate_consignment, reject_order, reject_subscription.
- Eligibility (status/window/tier, system never checks): extend_account, get_rider_details, list_contract_details, reject_order, reject_subscription, unfreeze_manifest; unmet -> deny.
- Confirm (recap + explicit yes): extend_account, reinstate_consignment, reject_order, reject_subscription, unfreeze_manifest.
- list_consignment_details: unrestricted.

INSURANCE ENDORSEMENT PROVISIONS

§1 Qualification. check_grievance_details, create_claim, extend_membership_plan, and merge_endorsement are permissible only where the qualifying conditions of status, temporal window, and tier obtain; the platform undertakes no such examination, and their failure mandates refusal.

§2 Identification. check_grievance_details, extend_membership_plan, and merge_endorsement shall not proceed until identity stands verified through inspect_mortgage_details upon the customer's email; in default, obtain the email, verify, and resume.

§3 Dormancy. The four operations of §1 shall be refused where the target record stands frozen or terminal.

§4 Limits upon Values. The same four admit only argument values within the limits fixed by policy.

§5 Antecedent Grievance. check_grievance_details, create_claim, and merge_endorsement presuppose prior production of the grievance record by check_grievance_details upon the currency — itself governed, whence the gateway act. In default, obtain the currency, produce, and resume.

# 통신사 환불·모기지 데스크 규정

기준 6종: 클레임 상향(escalate_claim), 모기지 조회(fetch_mortgage_details), 환불 철회(revoke_refund), 예약 분할(split_reservation), 계정 정지(suspend_account), 모기지 정지(suspend_mortgage).

## 본인 확인
6종 전부 본인 확인 선행 필수. 확인 수단: 지점코드(branch_code)로 view_complaint_details 호출. 미확인이면 지점코드를 받아 확인 후 재시도.

## 선행 조회
6종 전부, 실행 전에 바우처 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다: 멤버십(membership)으로 view_voucher_details 호출이 선행 단계.

## 소유권
6종 전부, 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용.

## 동결 기록
suspend_account 를 제외한 5종은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절.

## 자격 요건
revoke_refund 를 제외한 5종은 자격 요건(상태·기간·등급) 충족 시에만 허용 — 미충족 시 거절. 시스템 무검사.

## 인자 한도
split_reservation 을 제외한 5종, 전달 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절.

## 변경 전 동의
escalate_claim, split_reservation, suspend_account, suspend_mortgage 는 내역 제시 후 명시적 동의(예)를 받고서만 실행. (fetch_annuity_details, inspect_manifest_details 는 무제한.)

# Travel Riders & Claims Compendium

The Big Ten: create_shipment, deactivate_voucher, find_complaint_details, freeze_claim, get_rider_details, reject_grievance, retrieve_endorsement_details, split_loan, upgrade_rider, view_appointment_details. (check_rebate_details lives outside every rule.)

A. Identity — the Big Ten in full: verify the caller first via find_complaint_details on the date of birth; the lookup is one of the Ten, hence the opening move. Unverified -> collect date of birth, verify, retry.
B. Standing — the Big Ten in full require the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier); unmet -> deny, and the system never checks.
C. Appointment on file — the Big Ten MINUS freeze_claim: the appointment record must be up first, via view_appointment_details on the branch code. Missing -> ask for branch code, pull, retry.
D. Frozen targets — the Big Ten MINUS freeze_claim are denied on frozen or terminal records.
E. Values — the Big Ten MINUS create_shipment take only in-policy argument values.
F. Consent — the six writes (create_shipment, deactivate_voucher, freeze_claim, reject_grievance, split_loan, upgrade_rider): recap details, explicit yes first.

# Telecom Reinstatements Policy

## Scope
Nine operations are governed: freeze_quote, get_annuity_details, list_annuity_details, modify_manifest, reinstate_account, reinstate_appointment, reinstate_deposit, retrieve_claim_details, retrieve_grievance_details. lookup_shipment_details is unrestricted.

## Ownership
All nine apply exclusively to the authenticated customer's records; decline requests aimed at anyone else's.

## Identity
All nine require the customer's identity established beforehand. Identity is established by calling list_annuity_details with the date of birth — the call is itself governed, so it serves as the entry step. If unverified, collect the date of birth, run the lookup, then return to the request.

Logistics quotes, quick version.

Identity first: adjust_invoice, get_reservation_details, get_shipment_details, suspend_quote, and transfer_shipment all want the caller verified, and the way in is get_shipment_details with the email (yes, it's on the gated list itself). No email? Ask, verify, retry what they wanted.

Eligibility — status, time window, tier — covers adjust_invoice, get_reservation_details, get_shipment_details, and suspend_quote. The platform never checks it; unmet means you decline.

Frozen or closed-out target records shut down adjust_invoice, get_reservation_details, suspend_quote, and transfer_shipment — get_shipment_details is the only gated tool that still works on them.

Logistics rebates desk (fetch_subscription_details, fetch_warranty_details: unrestricted):

- Core seven: get_invoice_details, list_voucher_details, register_invoice, split_rebate, transfer_order, transfer_subscription, view_refund_details.
- ID first (all seven): verify via view_refund_details on the amount (in-set = opener); unverified -> get amount, verify, retry.
- Invoice loaded first (all seven): via get_invoice_details on the reason (also in-set); missing -> get reason, load, retry.
- Owner only (all seven).
- Eligibility, system-unchecked (all seven): unmet -> deny.
- Frozen/terminal target (seven MINUS list_voucher_details) -> deny.
- Value limits (seven MINUS split_rebate): in-policy values only.

BANKING RIDER COVENANTS

§1 The Governed Seven. cancel_contract, cancel_device, check_shipment_details, close_rider, list_consignment_details, renew_mortgage, and upgrade_account constitute the Governed Seven. get_contract_details and search_rebate_details stand outside these covenants.

§2 Identification. No member of the Governed Seven shall proceed absent prior verification of identity, effected through list_consignment_details upon the branch code — itself a member, whence the gateway act. In default, obtain the branch code, verify, and resume.

§3 Dormancy. The Governed Seven shall be refused where the target record stands frozen or terminal.

§4 Limits upon Values. The Governed Seven admit only argument values within the limits fixed by policy; exceedance entails denial, no platform examination existing.

§5 Qualification. The Governed Seven demand the qualifying conditions of status, temporal window, and tier; their failure mandates refusal.

§6 Assent. cancel_contract, cancel_device, renew_mortgage, and upgrade_account shall follow only upon recital of particulars and the customer's explicit affirmative.

# 통신사 예약·증서 데스크 규정

기준 8종: 보증 해지(cancel_warranty), 환불 하향(downgrade_refund), 예약 상향(escalate_appointment), 대출 조회(find_loan_details), 주문 조회(lookup_order_details), 증서 수정(modify_endorsement), 예약 등록(register_reservation), 보증금 조회(retrieve_deposit_details). (연금 조회 search_annuity_details 는 무제한.)

## 동결 기록
8종 전부, 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절.

## 선행 조회
8종 전부, 실행 전에 대출 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다: 전화번호(phone)로 find_loan_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체가 기준 8종에 포함되어 진입 단계.

## 본인 확인
modify_endorsement 를 제외한 7종은 본인 확인 선행 필수. 확인 수단: 등급(tier)으로 retrieve_deposit_details 호출. 미확인이면 등급을 받아 확인 후 재시도.

## 인자 한도
downgrade_refund 를 제외한 7종, 전달 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절. 시스템 무검사.

## 소유권
escalate_appointment 를 제외한 7종은 인증 고객 본인 기록에만 적용.

## 변경 전 동의
쓰기 5종 — cancel_warranty, downgrade_refund, escalate_appointment, modify_endorsement, register_reservation — 은 내역 제시 후 명시적 동의(예)를 받고서만 실행.
